Antiquarian who became the Ice King.

How Simon Petrikov connects

  • Character: Ice King — Simon Petrikov is the man the Ice King used to be.
  • Item: Ice Crown — Simon put on the Ice Crown and began to lose himself.
  • Character: Betty Grof — Betty spends the later story trying to save Simon.
  • Character: Marceline — Simon protected Marceline after the Mushroom War.
  • Series: Fionna and Cake — The sibling series returns to Simon after the crown.

What is Simon Petrikov?

Simon Petrikov is the pre-war scholar who bought a cursed crown to save Betty, protected young Marceline, and lost himself to Ice King.

Key threads lead to Ice King, Ice Crown, Betty Grof, Marceline and Fionna and Cake.
